task.title: Resetting superuser passwords on the Red Hat Quay Operator
task.shortdesc: To reset the superuser password on your Red Hat Quay Operator deployment, you can generate a bcrypt-hashed password with Python, log in to the PostgreSQL database with oc rsh and psql, and update the user table with the new hashed password.

ul.li: You have created a Red Hat Quay superuser.
You have installed the pip package manager for Python.
You have installed the bcrypt package for pip.

step.cmd: Log in to your Red Hat Quay deployment.
On the OpenShift Container Platform UI, navigate to Workloads → Secrets.
Select the namespace for your Red Hat Quay deployment, for example, Project quay.
